note.p: Mary Barker was the daughter of Thomas Barker of Penkridge, who married Mary Homfray at Wishaw on the 25 November 1773. She was mentioned in Robert Southey’s letter 2 December 1801 which spoke of Barker planning to spend the winter at Chalotte Smith’s. She was a subscriber to Mrs Darwall’s poems in 1794. She died in 1851. Miss Barker was also mentioned in Sarah Hutchinson’s letters, where she described Mary as “kind natured a creature as ever lived”.
